d:
The Grizzlies defeated the Wizards, 136-120 tonight in Washington. Cameron Boozer contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 7 rebounds 7 assists and 7 three pointers, with Zach Edey of the Grizzlies adding an additional 23 points (10-15 FG) in the game. Anthony Davis finished with a team-high 23 points along with 4 rebounds for the Wizards in the losing effort. The Grizzlies improve their record to 10-4 with the win, while the Wizards fall to 4-11 for the season.
